    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Column
    Annotation to map a field to a specific column index in a delimited file.
    Customer
    Model class representing a customer record from a comma-delimited file.
    FileSource
    Annotation to specify the delimiter used in a flat file source.
    GenericFileParser<T>
    Generic file parser that converts delimited flat files into Java objects using annotations.
    NotNull
    Validation annotation to ensure a field value is not null.
    NotNullValidationStrategy
    Validation strategy that enforces non-null field values.
    ParsingException
    Custom unchecked exception thrown when file parsing or data conversion fails.
    Range
    Validation annotation to enforce numeric boundaries on a field value.
    RangeValidationStrategy
    Validation strategy that enforces numeric range constraints.
    Regex
    Validation annotation to enforce that a field's string representation matches a regular expression pattern.
    RegexValidationStrategy
    Validation strategy that enforces regular expression pattern matching.
    SecurityAudit
    Model class representing a security audit log entry from a semicolon-delimited file.
    Transaction
    Model class representing a financial transaction record from a pipe-delimited file.
    ValidationStrategy
    Strategy interface for field-level validation operations.
    Validator
    Orchestrates validation of Java objects using multiple validation strategies.
